title: Illegal power tapping electrocutes 2 in Tamparan, 1 dead
summary: Two people were electrocuted on the afternoon of 17 July 2019 in Barangay Salongabanding, Tamparan, while trying to tap into a Lanao del Sur Electric Cooperative main line. One died and the other was hospitalized with serious burns.

sources.title: Illegal electric tapping kills 1, injures another in Lanao Sur

title: Fire guts former mayor's ancestral house in Bubong
summary: A fire destroyed the two-storey ancestral house of a former mayor in Barangay Muntian, Bubong, in November 2019; the BFP declared it out at 5:03 pm. No one was hurt, 7 families were displaced and damage was placed at PHP 400,000.

sources.title: Fire guts ex-mayor's ancestral house in Bubong, Lanao del Sur

title: Fire destroys temporary classrooms at Marawi resettlement site
summary: A fire that broke out around 6 pm on 18 February 2021 destroyed a temporary school building used by Dansalan National High School at a resettlement site for families displaced by the 2017 Marawi siege. Firefighters from the provincial government and Saguiaran controlled it in about 20 minutes; no one was hurt but books and learning modules were lost.

sources.title: Fire destroys temporary classrooms, books for Marawi evacuees' children

title: Lake Lanao swelling floods 11 barangays in Masiu
summary: Frequent thunderstorm rain swelled Lake Lanao and flooded 11 barangays of Masiu on 15 September 2022, affecting 759 households (3,795 people) and displacing 127 who stayed with relatives. No deaths, injuries or missing persons were reported.

sources.title: Philippines, Flooding in Lanao del Sur (BARMM)

title: Flash floods in southern Lanao del Sur kill teen, 3 missing
summary: Heavy rain from the intertropical convergence zone sent flash floods through Malabang, Balabagan, Kapatagan and Marogong on the night of 9 July 2024. A boy of about 14 drowned in Kapatagan, a 15-year-old male was missing there, and a 2-year-old boy and his 3-year-old sister were missing in Balabagan after their house was swept away; 4 people were injured, 4,990 households were evacuated from 82 barangays and 665 houses were damaged.

title: Uprooted tree falls on tricycle in Malabang, 4 children dead
summary: A tree uprooted by severe weather fell on a tricycle in Malabang on Friday, 13 September 2024. Four minors aged 7 to 15 died and three other minors were hospitalized, according to the Bangsamoro Ministry of Social Services and Development.

title: Dawn fire destroys 12 houses in Marogong
summary: A fire at dawn on 11 October 2024 in Barangay Proper, Marogong, destroyed 12 houses and partially damaged 9 others, displacing at least 20 families. No one was hurt; damage was estimated at about PHP 2 million and the cause was under investigation.
